final_prompt: Asset type: final concept approval sheet for MM-TOY-003

Because both wheels share one transverse axis, the far wheel is exactly hidden behind the near wheel and the side silhouette contains one circular tire, not an extra wheel. Match the exact same rover identity as the unchanged panels.
Avoid: changing the left hero panel; changing the bottom-right exploded panel; front view in the upper-right; any skid touching the ground.
